create_data_sample_with_metainfo: create a DataSample with image shape and num_classes metainfo fields
set_gt_label: set the ground truth label on a DataSample instance with a single or multi label
set_pred_score: set the predicted score tensor on a DataSample and auto infer num_classes
set_mask: set a mask tensor on a DataSample for masked image modeling tasks
review_data_sample_repr: review the DataSample class repr method to understand metainfo and data field output
